title: VERTEX In-Game HUD Consolidation & Sector 0 Root Genesis Overhaul
brief: Eliminate duplicated boxes and colliding buttons across Heist, Hacker, Cybersecurity, and redesign Sector 0: Root Genesis with Triad Daemon visual identity

artboards.title: Unified Tactical Dock (Heist & Hacker Modes)
artboards.tradeoff: Maximum screen clarity: Top bar is strictly read-only telemetry; Bottom bar holds all clickable/touchable actions with dynamic flex spacing and zero duplicate panels.

artboards.title: Floating Pills + Direct Node Radial Context (Cybersecurity Mode)
artboards.tradeoff: More open canvas in the corners via floating islands and direct node radial actions; tailored for Blue Team SOC command.

artboards.title: Sector 0: Root Genesis (The Triad Breach — Architect-0 / Kain)
artboards.tradeoff: Replaces the flat gray cement background and colliding labels with a deep crimson/triad hypervisor canvas, curved non-overlapping CROSS_SYNC edges, distinct octagonal/hexagonal daemon nodes, and Kain's TCP steganography hints.
